The puck on the left is black with red and white graphics, featuring a large 'L' logo and text reading 'LEAGUE CHAMPIONS'. The puck on the right has a multi-colored design (blue, yellow, red) with stylized text that appears to read 'CHAMPIONSHIP' or similar, though the lettering is distorted. Both pucks exhibit the standard cylindrical disk shape with visible edge ridges.
